description: Named changes the harness's fixture server applies to tests/fixtures/site/ for side B (target fixture:<name>). edits: exact text that must occur once in the file, and its replacement. remove: files that answer 404. The selftest (tests/harness/negative.py) runs each against the unchanged site.

color-1-of-255.describe: h1 color rgb(45, 49, 56) to rgb(46, 49, 56): 1/255, inside the tolerance

whitespace.describe: one rendered space added between the lead paragraph's link and the period after it (the old own-text rule collapsed it away: a space that renders between two inline boxes, as in the footer of round 1 of the Phase 1 fixes)

whitespace-collapsed.describe: source whitespace that renders nothing changes: the list items lose the newline and indentation between them (whitespace between blocks), and the h1's space before <b> becomes a newline and indentation (still one rendered space)

whitespace-nbsp.describe: no-break spaces in the lead paragraph, which CSS never collapses: the space after "Lead" becomes   plus a space, and the space before the link becomes two   (round 1's own-text rule read U+00A0 as collapsible whitespace and gave no record for either, as in the adversarial review's 'Code  licensed' footer)

inserted-same-tag.describe: a <section> inserted before two other sections (same tag as its neighbours)

changed-tag-content.describe: fixture becomes fixtures: another tag and another word

progress-code-token.describe: the max token in the masked progress code changes from 100 to 200 (outside the value mask)

head-data.describe: the JSON-LD data block's version and url change while it is re-indented and its keys reordered, and a <base target> is added: three head records ($.version, $.url, base target) and nothing else

head-data-copy.describe: a second copy of the JSON-LD data block at the end of <body>, re-indented with its keys reordered but with the same leaves, as React's client render after a hydration mismatch adds one on the oracle's /docs/progress: an exact copy is counted once, so zero differences, and side B's head_repeats is 1

head-data-near-copy.describe: a second JSON-LD data block at the end of <body> that differs from the first in one leaf (version 1.0.1): not a copy, so it is its own entry script[type=application/ld+json]#2, one head record per leaf (9) on side B only, and nothing else

cross-origin.describe: a script inserts a stylesheet <link> to this server under another host name (localhost instead of 127.0.0.1), a URL built at run time with no URL literal; the stylesheet is the page's own, so nothing renders differently: the run fails on one cross-origin load per cell (criterion 15) with zero differences

edits.new:
<script src="/fixture.js"></script>
<script>
  (function () {
    var l = document.createElement("link");
    l.rel = "stylesheet";
    l.href = location.protocol + "//localhost:" + location.port + "/fixture.css";
    document.head.appendChild(l);
  })();
</script>

cross-origin-frame.describe: a hidden same-origin <iframe srcdoc> whose script inserts a stylesheet <link> to this server under another host name (localhost), a URL built at run time: the load is in the frame's own Resource Timing, not the page's, so this proves the check reads nested frames: one cross-origin load per cell (side B), and the only record is the iframe's own only-b structure record

<footer class="site">Fixture footer</footer>

registry-evasion.describe: one change of each element and head record kind at once (for registry-evasion): the h1 color by 2/255 (style), the lead paragraph's title (attribute) and one of its words (text), a fourth list item (structure), and the title (head)

runtime-class.describe: the registry-evasion changes, and an inline script that adds class js-added to <html> on load (for registry-runtime): the page source has no such class, so a static read of it finds an entry keyed to .js-added reaching nothing, while on the live document it reaches every element

missing-index.describe: /index.html answers 404 on side B (for registry-missing-page): a page side B does not have

cross-origin-worker.describe: a script starts a dedicated worker (/worker.js) that fetches this server's stylesheet under another host name (localhost), a URL built at run time: a worker's loads are in no page's Resource Timing, so only the proxy's CSP report shows it: one cross-origin load per cell (side B), zero differences

cross-origin-closed-shadow.describe: a hidden <iframe srcdoc> inside a closed shadow root, whose script inserts this server's stylesheet under another host name (localhost), a URL built at run time: no script outside can reach a closed shadow root, so the page cannot read that frame's Resource Timing and only the proxy's CSP report shows the load: one cross-origin load per cell (side B), and the shadow host's own only-b structure record

sections-geometry.describe: the one page gets a third grid track at 1300 px (every section narrower there) and 16 px less content width at 375 px; Alpha's lead paragraph changes color, one item's text and the paragraph's title change, and a ninth item is added, at every width

edits.new:
<style>
  /* A third grid track at 1300 px only, as the one page keeps the table of contents' track (PLAN.md
     Phase 3 contract 5): every section's boxes are narrower there. These rules come before sections.css, so
     they name body to win. */
  @media (width: 1300px) { body .docs { grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr) 160px; } }
  /* At 375 px the content column loses 16 px: a geometry change at another width. */
  @media (width: 375px) { body .docs > #content { padding-inline: 8px; } }
  /* Alpha's lead paragraph changes color at every width. */
  hgroup:has(#alpha) + .body .intro { color: rgb(200, 0, 0); }
</style>

reread-transient.describe: a script in the head gives the h1 word-spacing 3px on this route's first load in a browser session only: it sets a cookie, which the harness never clears (differ.js load empties localStorage and sessionStorage only), and a later load that finds the cookie changes nothing. So the first cell of /index.html in each session differs and its reread does not (for reread-transient and reread-transient-off)

edits.new:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/fixture.css">
<script>
  (function () {
    if (document.cookie.split("; ").indexOf("fixture-seen-index=1") < 0) {
      document.cookie = "fixture-seen-index=1; path=/";
      var s = document.createElement("style");
      s.textContent = "h1 { word-spacing: 3px; }";
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    }
  })();
</script>
</head>

reread-error.describe: the reread-transient script, and on every later load in the session a stylesheet <link> to /missing.css, which answers 404: the first read differs, and the reread's side B fails the stylesheet check twice, a harness error (for reread-error)

reread-partial.describe: the h1 color change of color-2-of-255 on every load, and a script in the head that marks the route seen with the cookie of reread-transient: on this route's first load in a browser session it gives the h1 word-spacing 3px, on every later load word-spacing 5px and the lead paragraph letter-spacing 1px. So the session's first cell of /index.html has the color and word-spacing records on its first read, and on its reread the same records (word-spacing with another value) plus letter-spacing records only the reread has (for reread-partial)

reread-first-read.describe: a script in the head counts this route's loads in a browser session in a cookie, which the harness never clears. The first two loads get the h1 word-spacing 3px and a stylesheet <link> to /missing.css (404), and the second also the cross-origin stylesheet of control cross-origin (this server under localhost); later loads change nothing. So the session's first cell of /index.html fails the stylesheet check, is loaded once more and fails again (a harness error), with the planted records and a cross-origin load, and its reread is clean (for reread-first-read)

edits.new:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/fixture.css">
<script>
  (function () {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )fixture-loads-index=(\d+)/);
    var n = (m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0) + 1;
    document.cookie = "fixture-loads-index=" + n + "; path=/";
    if (n > 2) return;
    var s = document.createElement("style");
    s.textContent = "h1 { word-spacing: 3px; }";
    document.head.appendChild(s);
    var l = document.createElement("link");
    l.rel = "stylesheet";
    l.href = "/missing.css";
    document.head.appendChild(l);
    if (n === 2) {
      var x = document.createElement("link");
      x.rel = "stylesheet";
      x.href = location.protocol + "//localhost:" + location.port + "/fixture.css";
      document.head.appendChild(x);
    }
  })();
</script>
</head>
